h: Gunmen reportedly abduct members of a security group linked to Sunday Igboho in Kwara
p: Members of the Iru Ekun Security Group, which is associated with Yoruba nation agitator Sunday Igboho, were reportedly abducted by gunmen in Kwara State. Police have not yet said whether a rescue operation is under way.
more: The number of people taken has not been confirmed.
Kwara has seen several kidnapping incidents in recent months.
